body:
_Migrated from issue #838, filed 2026-07-11._

Expired or rejected Hardcover tokens are visible only in logs. Admin should show token status so expiry does not require log archaeology.

Credit: @WasabiBurns and #479.

Promise (2026-06-17): “surfacing token status in the UI is worth doing. No need to open a separate issue, I’ll track it from here.”

Source: https://github.com/new-usemame/Calibre-Web-NextGen/issues/479

resolution.note: Verified in code: config_edit.html renders the Hardcover key field plus a token-source help block driven by config.hardcover_token_source(). Migrated as open; fix predated migration.

title: Surface Hardcover token status in admin
